## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style and conventions.
- [ ] I have executed local verification tests (`python -m unittest test_engine_verify.py`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`).
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed without regressions.
